postconditions.expression: all(c in (a + b) for c in result)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result is in the concatenation of the two input strings.
Each character in the result appears exactly once in the concatenation of the two input strings.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in a or c not in b for c in result)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result is not present in both input strings.
